description: This file defines a class 'Formula' that handles conversion of formulas, cell references, and defined names within the PHPSpreadsheet library's ODS writer component.

classes.name: Formula
classes.description: A class responsible for converting formulas, cell references, and named ranges for ODS format within PHPSpreadsheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with an array of DefinedName objects, storing their names.

methods.name: convertFormula
methods.description: Converts a formula string by applying cell reference and defined name conversions, ensuring it starts with '=', and prefixing with 'of:'.

methods.name: convertDefinedNames
methods.description: Identifies and converts defined names within a formula to a format suitable for ODS.

methods.name: convertCellReferences
methods.description: Converts cell references in a formula to ODS-compatible notation, handling worksheets, columns, and rows.
